primary_business_description.value: Item 1. Business QUALCOMM Incorporated (QCOM) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. Qualcomm develops and licenses wireless technology and sells fabless mobile and connectivity semiconductor products (QCT) and licensing (QTL). Principal operations: QUALCOMM Incorporated. Reported segments include: QCT (82% of revenue); QTL (18% of revenue). Our semiconductor business model is fabless.
